body.name: Catice
body.description: A sword forged from the shards of the Ice Queen's tears. Though fragile and prone to breaking, its fierce icy blade summons delicate whirlwinds of snowflakes, reforming itself to its original form.
body.effect: Upon hitting a target or object, the blade violently shatters. If the blade hits a target, shatter will deal up to an additional 25 ice magical damage. The broken blade regenerates to its original state over 4 seconds, reducing shatter damage until the blade is fully reformed.

body.name: Cursed Bandage
body.description: A bloodstained bandage, steeped in the pain and screams of those lost to a horrific experiment. Offer it to the Nightmare Mummy, who will cleanse it and pray for the dead.

body.name: Cursed Bell
body.description: When this bell is rung, a clear chime echoes out, but faintly within it is a sound like the dying scream of the Midnight Stag. If the bell is sounded atop the pentagram drawn somewhere within the Inferno, it will summon the Ghost King.

body.name: Cursed Crown
body.description: A majestic crown befitting the ruler of this domain, forever the eternal sovereignty over the darkness.
